summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-X5 admits no external crate. academic-cs-map links academic-domain, serde and thiserror as product edges, and academic-domain, serde_json, trybuild and uuid as dev edges, all covered by earlier reviewed receipts, and adds one workspace path package. Nothing links into a product binary that was not already there: academic-domain is a path package this repository already builds, and serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt. Build-time-only additions are zero -- there is no build script, no proc macro beyond serde's and thiserror's, and no code generator.
summary.added_workspace_path_package_note: academic-cs-map is the P2-X5 boundary: section 26.1's stable multiscale atlas with its four semantic zoom levels and its golden-coordinate layout, section 26.2's eight visual channels each with its own value type, section 26.3's one-base-two-overlay composition with its collision warning and pinned legend, section 26.4's five focus modes and three-stage search reveal, section 26.5's timeline scrubber and split view with the transition kind the bitemporal contract deliberately left to the view, and section 25.3's first screen, lens rail and YOU anchor. It owns the atlas, whose coordinates are a pure function of identity and a growth band and are compared against a committed golden file; the encodings, whose eight value types are eight so that they vary independently; the lens composition, whose overlay method takes self by value so that a refused third leaves nothing behind; the focus modes, each of which names a node set and an edge rule written out in the contract; the reveal, which holds a cluster, a path and a node and has one producer; and the timeline, whose projection reads both bitemporal coordinates and neither in place of the other. It is a separate package from academic-domain because that crate owns what a node, an edge, a mastery, a freshness and a change origin are, and this one owns how they are drawn, and the direction of the edge is what keeps a picture impossible without the vocabulary and the vocabulary declarable without a picture.

no_second_vocabulary_note: Section 7.1's thirty-seven node types and section 7.2's twenty predicates were implemented by the predicate registry, and this crate adds neither again: a MapNode carries academic_domain::predicates::NodeType and a MapEdge carries PredicateName, so a zoom level's admitted type set and a focus mode's edge rule are stated in the registry's own vocabulary. Section 13.1's six mastery levels and section 13.3's six freshness bands were implemented by P2-N2 and P2-N3, and MasteryFill and FreshnessRing wrap those enumerations rather than banding them again -- this crate has no ladder, no decay and no time input, so a fill cannot disagree with the state that produced it. Section 30.2's nine epistemic statuses are read by EdgeStroke::of as a total match with exactly two classes, so the dashed/solid partition is a function of that enumeration rather than a second status vocabulary. P2-C6's four ChangeOrigins are the Some image of MapTransition::change_origin, compared against CHANGE_ORIGINS in both directions; the fifth arm, UserScopeChange, returns None, which is the bitemporal contract's own recorded decision that a display setting is not canonical history -- and no From, Into, Deref, AsRef, TryFrom or free function converts one into the other in either direction, which the whole-set impl-header inventory in crates/cs-map/tests/cs_map_scans.rs states over every type pair rather than over a named list. Section 26.2's opacity bullet is held the same way: LensRelevance and MasteryFill are two types, the whole set of public functions returning a LensRelevance by value is compared against two and neither names a mastery type, and the whole set of public signatures naming both is compared against the empty set with each half shown separately non-empty. Which of section 26.2's channels each of section 25.3's ten lenses claims is derived from the design document at run time by searching each lens's own spec name in each encoding bullet, in both directions, so four and six are measurements rather than counts written here.

direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: EntityId for what a placement is of; predicates::NodeType and predicates::PredicateName for what a node and an edge are; MasteryLevel, FreshnessBand, EpistemicStatus and ConfidencePermille for four of the eight channels; and temporal::TimeCoordinates and temporal::ChangeOrigin for the scrubber. Naming those rather than declaring a second vocabulary is what makes a drawn node the same entity the ledger holds and a drawn transition the same origin the recomputation explainer reports.

dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: Declared a second time for the trybuild reason academic-scenario gives: a compile-fail case compiles against the crate under test plus that crate's dev-dependencies, and six of the eight cases name a domain value -- a MasteryLevel, a NodeType, a PredicateName, an EntityId or a ChangeOrigin.
dev_workspace_dependencies.serde_json: the_serialized_key_sets_are_closed. The drawn node, the drawn edge, a scrubber projection, a split comparison and a legend are each serialized and their key sets compared in both directions, and the eight channel keys are additionally required to be exactly VISUAL_CHANNELS own keys. That is the closure P2-Y3 measured one task earlier -- a cross-row aggregation whose content every named test agreed with and whose serialized shape nobody compared. It is a dev edge only, so no parser is in the drawing path: the product tree renders nothing.
dev_workspace_dependencies.trybuild: The compile-fail suite. Section 25.3's, 26.2's, 26.3's and 26.5's separations are types, and the eight cases under crates/cs-map/tests/compile_fail assert that each refusal is a program that does not compile with a committed diagnostic -- an opacity built from a mastery, the same conversion the other way, a map transition converted to a change origin, a composition retried after its third overlay was refused, a YOU anchor declared as a node, a search reveal assembled with no path, a hop count written as a number, and an edge inserted into a declared graph.
dev_workspace_dependencies.uuid: Deterministic UUIDv7-shaped fixture identities, derived from a digest of the fixture's name rather than from a clock. The same helper P2-N2's, P2-Y1's and P2-Y3's suites use, and what lets the five-thousand-node fixture be generated from a rule stated in the test tree rather than stored in a file.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-cs-map is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns sections 25.3, 26.1 through 26.5 and section 19's layout-stability half, whose whole content is that a picture must not say more than the record says. Six separations hold that rather than a sentence. Opacity is not mastery: LensRelevance and MasteryFill are two types, the only producers of the first are relevance_of and a delegation to it over the base lens, neither of their parameter lists names a mastery type, the whole set of public signatures naming both is empty with each half shown separately non-empty, and the whole set of impl headers this crate declares is pinned in both directions and required to name no conversion trait for any type pair at all -- which is the bypass class P2-Y3 measured, a From implementation escaping every public-function sweep because a trait impl declares no pub fn. An inference is not a confirmation: EdgeStroke::of is a total match over section 30.2's nine statuses with exactly two classes and Disputed and Superseded are on the dashed side, which is stated in the contract rather than left to a reader. YOU is not a place: YouAnchor has no EntityId, cannot be handed to MapNode::declare and therefore cannot reach MapGraph::declare, and the absence is checked by sweeping twenty-one produced surfaces each required to be non-empty first rather than by naming the one place somebody might have put it. A display setting is not history: MapTransition::UserScopeChange returns None from change_origin, the Some image is compared against academic_domain::temporal::CHANGE_ORIGINS in both directions, and the whole set of public signatures returning a bare ChangeOrigin is compared against the empty set. A third overlay leaves nothing behind: LensComposition::overlay takes self by value, and the whole base-by-overlay-by-overlay-by-overlay product -- ten thousand orderings, thirty thousand insertions -- is enumerated with each verdict re-derived in the test. And the layout is free of the view: lay_out takes a graph and nothing else, no lens, overlay, focus mode, zoom level or instant is a parameter, the coordinates are pinned in a committed golden file, and the drift bound is required to be attained by the widest size pair so that it is known to be tight rather than merely generous. Its dependency set is minimal and the edges it does not have are the point: no academic-store, academic-vault or academic-projections, so nothing here reaches the canonical writer or a snapshot sidecar and no migration is added; no academic-knowledge-state and no academic-freshness, so no ladder and no decay is in the closure; no academic-critical-path and no academic-blind-spot, so the halo and the gap glyph are displayed rather than decided; and no academic-worker and no academic-egress-boundary, so nothing in its closure can launch a process or stage a payload.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, opens no file, reads no clock, declares no foreign function, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. It spells no std::fs name at all: every graph, reading, lens, coordinate and instant arrives as an argument. the_cs_map_crate_touches_no_file_and_no_socket in crates/cs-map/tests/cs_map_scans.rs compares the whole set of its use items against a 27-entry inventory, the whole set of the two-segment paths it reaches through a crate root -- one, serde::Serializer, with use items stripped first so an import is not counted as a reach -- and the whole set of the macros it invokes -- two, matches and vec -- against pinned inventories in both directions, and runs a whole-identifier pass for nineteen filesystem, clock, process and transport constructs over every file of the package, tests included, with Instant, SystemTime and a bare now among them. every_public_signature_is_in_the_inventory compares all 87 public signatures against a pinned inventory in both directions; every_impl_header_in_this_crate_is_in_the_inventory compares all 30 impl headers the same way and then refuses every conversion trait over the whole inventory; and every_field_of_this_crate_is_in_the_inventory compares all 96 declared fields in both directions and refuses an f32 or an f64 in any declared type, so an opacity expressed as a fraction has no name to arrive under. libc reaches its link closure through academic-domain, the same way it reaches every other pure crate whose only product edge is that one; the crate spells no socket construct, which is why its SOCKET_ALLOWANCE entry is absent rather than empty. Every graph, reading, timeline and coordinate in its test tree is synthetic and built in process, and the test tree writes no file: the two committed fixtures under testdata/cs-map/ are read and never rewritten by a test.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-cs-map links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. trybuild is a dev dependency already admitted for academic-scenario, academic-desktop, academic-proposal, academic-repository-classification, academic-repository-competency, academic-competency, academic-role-profile and academic-readiness; serde_json is a dev dependency already admitted for academic-competency, academic-role-profile and academic-readiness; and uuid is a dev dependency already admitted for academic-knowledge-state, academic-competency and academic-readiness. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
